concerns.text: T004 still instructs 'selects stratified random window start indices for each interval length L' while T023 (the FR-002 correction) prescribes 100 non-overlapping windows per L via seeded contiguous tiling. Two tasks feeding the same pipeline prescribe contradictory window-selection methods; T004 must be updated (or explicitly marked superseded by T023) so the FR-002 non-overlapping/100-windows constraint is not silently violated by the earlier task.

SC-006(b) requires 'programmatically detecting a horizontal line at autocorrelation = 0' in the generated image, but T014's unit tests verify only 'presence of the zero-contour artist' via a recorded artist list during re-plotting — they never inspect the rendered PNG. This is exactly the failure mode that caused the original T014 rejection (artist present, image broken/missing). The verification must operate on the saved PNG (e.g., pixel-level detection of the dashed black contour) to preserve the acceptance criterion.

US-3 acceptance scenario 2 requires the heatmap PNG to 'pass an automated checksum verification', but T026 computes SHA-256 checksums only 'for all files under data/'. No task checksums outputs/figures/*.png, silently dropping this acceptance criterion. Extend T026 (or T014) to checksum the three heatmap PNGs.

Constitution VI mandates ALL autocorrelation sums use 'exact integer arithmetic or verified arbitrary-precision libraries'. T024 (following plan 2.2–2.3) computes all ~5.56 M values in float64 FFT and exactly cross-validates only a seeded sample of ≥100 (window, lag) pairs per L. The plan's Constitution Check table claims '✅' compliance, but the task list implements a sampled verification of a small fraction of the mandated computations — a semantic weakening presented as compliance. Either the constitution must be amended to sanction the cross-validation approach, or the tasks must not claim Principle VI compliance.

T005 writes demo output to data/results/demo_autocorr.csv, a path absent from the data model and plan project structure, and T006 asserts on it. Minor traceability gap under Constitution III/IV; either add the artifact to the data model or relocate it under data/processed/.

The constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed in the project state file's artifact_hashes map; tasks record checksums only in data/checksums/manifest.sha256 and no task updates the state YAML. Reconcile the two destinations (e.g., have T026 also write artifact_hashes to the state file).
